layer1.name: Kite
layer1.one_liner: AI-powered code completion for developers, as a free editor plugin.
layer1.description: A desktop plugin that suggested whole lines and functions as developers typed, trained on public code. Free to use, with a paid Pro tier planned for teams. At t0 it had strong developer adoption and no proven way to charge for it.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down and open-sourced. The founder's postmortem gives two reasons: the technology was roughly a decade too early, and the product reached ~500k monthly active developers without ever monetising.
